name: Kissmanga
draft_reason: kissmanga.in serves Cloudflare's interactive 'Just a moment...' challenge to every plain HTTP request (verified 2026-08-30: HTTP 403 on / and /mangalist). This port uses plain fetch, so every call fails. Publishing it needs the challenged requests rewritten to call __browserFetch and requires_browser_fetch set to true here, then verification against the live site — not just flipping draft. The scraping code is otherwise complete and still builds and smoke-tests.
